fusions.name: Decoy Scuffle
fusions.desc: Kicks up a flapping commotion that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to confuse the target for 4 seconds, turning it on its allies.

fusions.name: Lifted Grain
fusions.desc: Flings a pilfered scrap that deals 8 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Slippery Roost
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds. You jink 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Nimble Pilferer
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds. Your dodge chance is also 5% higher at all times.
